_comment: Burn-down baseline for declared-but-absent brand logo assets (SYN-1133). Every path in `brands[*].logo` must resolve under public/ or be listed here. These 21 predate the guard: no brand logo file has ever existed on disk, and because no runtime code reads the `logo` field the gap never errored. Listing them keeps CI green while making any NEW brand's missing artwork fail the build. Burn the list down as artwork lands — the test also fails if an entry here now resolves, so a stale baseline cannot hide. Do NOT add entries to unblock a new brand; commission the asset instead.
